profile.summary:
I'm a full stack developer with 8+ years of experience building web applications on the MEAN and MERN stacks — Node.js and Express on the server, React and Angular in the browser, and MongoDB for data.

On this site I share what I've learned along the way: in-depth blog posts on the JavaScript ecosystem and step-by-step tutorials for people starting out.
